title: schorm Configuration (schorm.config.yml)
description: The schorm.config.yml file at a schorm project root: global build configuration.

scorm_version.description: Target SCORM version. Currently "2004-4th" is the only fully supported value - the generated manifest always declares SCORM 2004 4th Edition.

theme.description: Path to the theme directory (relative to the project root) containing layouts/, partials/ and assets/. 'schorm init' copies the default theme to ./theme.
